facts.fact: Yuko 骑摩托二十分钟回到被花生田与太阳能板包围的公寓
facts.anchor: returned to my apartment, which was surrounded by peanut fields

facts.fact: 晚餐是冷冻汉堡排加热、冻干味噌汤冲泡、冰箱里的生菜小番茄
facts.anchor: I took rice and a hamburg steak from the freezer

facts.fact: 隔壁传来一家三口的笑声，Yuko 熄掉手机屏隔着薄墙仔细听
facts.anchor: I clicked off my phone screen and listened carefully

facts.fact: 躺下后回想：与马对视只是今晨的事，却感觉很久以前，那双眼睛烙在心头
facts.anchor: those eyes were seared into my mind

facts.fact: 黑暗里传来叹息，呼吸声穿过磨砂玻璃滑门抵达耳边——有人在屋里
facts.anchor: The sound of lungs expelling air reached my ears through the frosted glass

facts.fact: 厨房暗处立着一匹马，眼睛映着窗外荧光灯，干草混牛奶的气味与白天一样
facts.anchor: The animal stood in front of the kitchen table

facts.fact: 马低鸣一声，Yuko 感到它是在呼唤自己
facts.anchor: let out a low-pitched whinny. I sensed that it was calling for me

facts.fact: 数步走近、颤抖的指尖碰到马颈的瞬间醒来——是梦；她咧嘴确认现实，发现自己裸睡
facts.anchor: The moment my shaking fingers made contact with the horse’s powerful neck, I woke up
